rationale: Fresh three-lens review (blind, edge-case, acceptance) against all 16 ACs in spec.md. All 16 ACs pass in the actual schema.sql on disk. No blocking findings survived triage. Six non-blocking deferred concerns noted: (1) smoke.sh SummingMergeTree count() assertion is brittle — should use sum(api_call_count)=1 instead of count()=1 to be reliable across unmerged parts; (2) ALTER TABLE DELETE in smoke.sh cleanup is async — a re-run within seconds may fail falsely; (3) cost_usd Float64 in coding_agent_cost_daily SummingMergeTree — Decimal(18,6) recommended for billing-grade precision; (4) user_email as leading ORDER BY key in coding_agent_logs creates a hotspot for Path B events (empty user_email) — known trade-off, hook queries route via coding_agent_hook_events; (5) api_call_count literal 1 in mv_cost_daily — toUInt64(1) would be more explicit; (6) no ALTER TABLE migration path for schema evolution. Blind lens raised a false concern about MV MATERIALIZED column timing — dismissed: ClickHouse guarantees MATERIALIZED columns are computed before MVs fire. Acceptance lens false-negatives on AC-4 and AC-12 were prompt artifacts (abbreviated schema); actual schema.sql includes both metrics tables and smoke.sh is present. Standards: commit format and branch name pass git-workflow.md; code quality N/A (SQL/bash only); gitleaks PASS.

business_review.title: Session key normalization
business_review.notes: session_id MATERIALIZED COALESCE(nullIf(LogAttributes['session.id'],''), nullIf(LogAttributes['session_id'],'')) unifies both Path A dot-notation and Path B underscore formats.

business_review.title: Raw log table matches otelcol-contrib 0.105.0 schema
business_review.notes: All required columns present: Timestamp, TraceId, SpanId, TraceFlags, SeverityText, SeverityNumber, ServiceName, Body, ResourceAttributes, LogAttributes as Map, plus Scope/Schema URL fields.

business_review.title: Traces table matches otelcol-contrib schema
business_review.notes: All required columns present including Events.* and Links.* flat arrays matching the otelcol-contrib 0.105.0 exporter schema.

business_review.title: Metrics tables match otelcol-contrib schema
business_review.notes: coding_agent_metrics_gauge and coding_agent_metrics_sum both present; sum table includes IsMonotonic and AggregationTemporality.

business_review.title: Hook events derived table
business_review.notes: coding_agent_hook_events populated automatically by mv_hook_events with no OTel Collector config change required.

business_review.title: MV routes hook events
business_review.notes: mv_hook_events filters all 6 event types, uses promoted session_id MATERIALIZED column (not raw LogAttributes map key).

business_review.title: Daily cost rollup table aggregates per (day, user_email, model_name, query_source, team_name)
business_review.notes: SummingMergeTree with ORDER BY (day, user_email, model_name, query_source, team_name); all token/cost columns present.

business_review.title: MV for cost rollup includes team_name
business_review.notes: mv_cost_daily filters event.name='api_request', maps all token/cost fields, includes ResourceAttributes['team.name'] as team_name.

business_review.title: All four read endpoints supported with ?team= filter
business_review.notes: All four endpoints have required tables; team_name promoted column in logs, hook_events, and cost_daily ORDER BY.

business_review.title: TTL and partitioning
business_review.notes: 90-day TTL on coding_agent_logs, coding_agent_traces, coding_agent_hook_events, and metrics tables; 365-day TTL on coding_agent_cost_daily; all monthly partitioned.

business_review.title: Idempotent DDL
business_review.notes: All 8 DDL objects use IF NOT EXISTS.

business_review.title: Smoke test validates objects and MV pipelines
business_review.notes: smoke.sh validates database, 6 tables, 2 MVs, and both MV routing paths via INSERT→SELECT assertions.

business_review.title: team_name promoted across coding_agent_logs, hook_events, cost_daily with bloom filters
business_review.notes: team_name MATERIALIZED from ResourceAttributes['team.name'] in logs (bloom filter idx_team_name); routed via mv_hook_events into hook_events (bloom filter idx_team_name); in cost_daily ORDER BY.

business_review.title: prompt_body stored for claude.prompt.submit events
business_review.notes: coding_agent_hook_events has prompt_body String; mv_hook_events populates from LogAttributes['prompt_body'].

business_review.title: Identity and sequence fields promoted in coding_agent_logs
business_review.notes: user_id (bloom filter), organization_id, agent_name, skill_name, event_sequence (toUInt32OrZero) all MATERIALIZED in coding_agent_logs.

business_review.title: Tool/interaction span fields promoted in coding_agent_traces
business_review.notes: file_path, subagent_type, span_skill_name (from SpanAttributes['skill_name']), interaction_sequence (toUInt32OrZero) all MATERIALIZED in coding_agent_traces.

standards_review.notes: All 3 commits follow EPMCDME-####: Description pattern.
No Python source files changed. SQL and bash deployment scripts are not subject to Ruff or the Apache 2.0 header checker.

gitleaks: no leaks found (verified 2026-07-17). No user-controlled SQL concatenation; all ClickHouse queries use parameterized map lookups. smoke.sh uses table-name variable in system.tables query but against an internal list, not user input.
